findings.detail: Line 546 emits `${t.common.completed} ...` (translated), then line 551 emits the literal `Click Export to download the results.` In Arabic the user now reads "اكتمل 12 items extracted." followed by an English sentence — and since this PR removes the automatic download, that sentence is the only prompt telling the user an action is still required. Impact is limited because the Export button's own label is hardcoded "Export" too (line 803), so the instruction still names what is on screen, and `docs/modules/MODULE_GUIDE.md:398-402` already documents this tab's log messages as English-only — that convention is what keeps this at low rather than medium. Note the e2e spec hardcodes the same literal (`e2e/ocr-text-input.spec.ts:85`), so localising it later requires touching both.
findings.summary: New completion instruction is hardcoded English next to a translated string
